sloka: तेषां नः स्वामिसन्देशान्निराशानां मुमूर्षताम् ।कार्यहेतोरिवायातः शकुनिर्वीर्यवान् महान् ।। ५.३५.६२।।।।
transliteration: teṣāṁ naḥ svāmisandeśānnirāśānāṁ mumūrṣatām ।kāryahetorivāyātaḥ śakunirvīryavān mahān ।। 5.35.62।।।।

translations.english: "When we were disappointed (in tracing you) and were at the point of death having been commanded by the king (that whosoever overstays would be killed) a gigantic powerful bird appeared to fulfil our task.
